concerns: Concurrent modification during paginated loop can skip items: in runWarmUpActions(), page increment is performed without tracking total count changes or sorting on a deterministic key, which might lead to skipping accounts if new accounts are added or modified concurrently during pagination.

Floating-point accumulation for trustScore: adding a literal double 0.1 to account.getTrustScore() can introduce precision issues over time due to binary floating-point representation; using BigDecimal or integer centi-scale values is preferred for financial-like or high-precision increment counters.

Fragile client-side timeout logic for files exceeding 200KB: the Svelte code triggers a extremely short 50ms AbortController timeout on the client side when files exceed 200KB. This might lead to unexpected timeouts in slow environments or high-latency networks even for standard valid files close to the size threshold.
